bead.title: bench-pr-A3c: cost budget accounting + budget_halted placeholders
bead.description:
PROBLEM: A sweep must stop spending once a USD cap is hit and must record why each un-run cell was skipped. Without budget accounting --max-cost-usd is inert and a sweep can overspend; without halted placeholders the skipped cells are indistinguishable from never-scheduled work.

ROOT CAUSE:
- Budget logic ported from cmd/bench/matrix.go: the pre-cell and post-cell halt checks at cmd/bench/matrix.go:806 and cmd/bench/matrix.go:933 (set ProcessOutcome="budget_halted"), the budget fields at cmd/bench/matrix.go:128-129 (BudgetUSD/PerRunBudgetUSD), and the final_status mapping at cmd/bench/matrix.go:1929.
- Bash anchors: the declared-but-unimplemented helpers budget_path / init_budget / append_budget_cell / budget_is_halted / write_budget_halted_cell (scripts/benchmark/benchmark:131-137) and the --max-cost-usd flag parsed by A2 (scripts/benchmark/benchmark:300-303). An existing Go probe TestBenchmarkBudgetHalt (cmd/bench/runner_a3_test.go:168) asserts budget.json structure (max_cost_usd/total_cost_usd/halted).

PROPOSED FIX (scripts/benchmark/benchmark):
- At each cell close, compute cost_usd_at_run_time = profile.pricing applied to the cell's token streams; accumulate into <out>/budget.json (fields: max_cost_usd, total_cost_usd, halted).
- Before scheduling the next cell, halt when total_cost_usd >= max_cost_usd (cap > 0).
- Cells skipped due to the halt get final_status=budget_halted placeholder reports with process_outcome=setup_failed and a 'note' field explaining the budget cut.

NON-SCOPE: arg parsing / matrix / --plan (A2); adapters + image (A1); core per-cell loop + report.json composition (A3a, prerequisite); resume/skip + --retry-invalid (A3b); per-cell transient retry + supersede links (A3d); flock/setsid/job-pool concurrency and SIGINT/SIGTERM handling (A4); Go agent-leak fix, Go deactivation, parity (A5). Parent out-of-scope preserved: PR B schema; PR C bench-set schema; PR D collector; PR E importers; PR F deleting cmd/bench; PR G docs. Governing artifact: docs/helix/02-design/plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.md.

DEPENDS ON: A3a (and transitively A2, A1). BLOCKS: A4.

ACCEPTANCE (satisfies parent A3 AC3 and grandparent AC3):
1. ./scripts/benchmark/benchmark --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary --max-cost-usd 0.01 produces at least one cell with final_status=budget_halted (process_outcome=setup_failed, note set), and writes/updates <out>/budget.json with max_cost_usd/total_cost_usd/halted. TestBudgetHaltPlaceholder (cmd/bench/runner_a3_test.go) and the existing TestBenchmarkBudgetHalt budget.json structure assertion remain green.
GATES: bats scripts/benchmark/test (and scripts/benchmark/tests/runner.bats) pass; `go test ./...` passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
bead.acceptance: Parent A3 AC3 and grandparent AC3 hold; acceptance 1 passes; bats, go test ./..., and lefthook run pre-commit all green.
